title: Regular expression compiled from input in python — review required
description: re.compile() builds a matcher from a runtime string. Python’s backtracking engine has no default timeout, so a pattern with nested quantifiers can consume a worker for an unbounded time on crafted input. The rule flags compilation from a non-literal argument.
remediation: Compile constant patterns only, escape user input with re.escape, cap input length, and run untrusted matches in a bounded worker.
limitation: Lexical: detects a non-literal first argument; patterns assembled in other modules are out of scope.
